variety_description: A high yielding, medium maturity, tall, long slender variety suitable for cultivation across country under rainfed lowland growing conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2018 for planting in Aman season having higher yield than commonly grown variety BRRI dhan49 and Swarna.
